verification.validation: Passed 27 identity frontend tests (session, LoginPage HTTPS/HTTP) plus 32 related shell/refusal/entry/style tests, frontend typecheck, and generated version/manifest checks. All SDK package versions are 0.53.17; companion CLI is unchanged at 0.52.11. Reuse the unchanged immutable executor release and its six digests. No full gate, NAS acceptance, Rust build, executor rebuild, publication or tag.

changes: A failed identity.status probe (timeout, 5xx, network, business_unavailable, restarting) no longer turns on the App's own sign-in: createSession keeps enabled false, sets unavailable and re-probes with bounded backoff
Add session.unavailable and session.retry(); only a successful {enabled:true} enables the App login
Add createSession(ctx, {identity:false}) for DSM-session-only Apps to skip the identity.status probe
LoginPage never renders the account/password form unless identity is enabled; it offers Retry while the probe is unavailable
Reuse the immutable executor/v0.53.5 release and its six digests
